stages.title: One work graph (keystone)
stages.notes: Deliver W1 per docs/CONDUCTOR-WORKGRAPH.md (W1.1 unify checkpoints+tasks into the event-sourced graph, W1.2 WorkGraphSync at every boundary, W1.3 claims from the graph + bug #6 fix, W1.4 one projection for all views). REUSE TaskGraph/TaskWrites/the G3 reload machinery — rewire, don't fork. The checkpoints table becomes a projection (ADR-0002 amended); sync is upsert-with-provenance, never clobbering runtime status. Truth gates are LIVE fake-agent tests (tools/fake-agent.ps1 pattern): mid-run /plan/edit stage add appears on the board; a task-done-only claim (no tracker edit) yields newlyDone=[item]; a post-advance verify prompt names the delivered stage.

stages.title: Real-provider claim path + honest prompts
stages.notes: Deliver W2 per docs/CONDUCTOR-WORKGRAPH.md (W2.1 claude-shaped --mcp-config + CONDUCTOR_PLAN in the child env so in-worker conductor verbs stop crashing on plan ambiguity; W2.2 live journal folding / direct events + single id allocator; W2.3 PromptBuilder renders PromptComposer blocks so GET /prompt/blocks IS the prompt, ToolContract rewritten to exactly one claim path). W2.1's truth gate needs one cheap real claude session — everything else is fake-agent/wire tests.

stages.title: Autonomy rails
stages.notes: Deliver W3 per docs/CONDUCTOR-WORKGRAPH.md (W3.1 independent watchdog timer + bg-only StallDetector liveness + clock-jump detection + hung-session notification; W3.2 401/authentication_failed classified as auth-park + doctor/preflight auth smoke test — replay session #13's raw log as the fixture; W3.3 SetConsoleCtrlHandler graceful close + ReapOrphans pid-reuse guard + unbounded-spend warning + bg start log pump fix). Independent of W1/W2 — safe to interleave.

stages.title: AI-native bootstrap + per-task pipeline control
stages.notes: Deliver W4 per docs/CONDUCTOR-WORKGRAPH.md (W4.1 ImportResult carries checkpoints — ToImportResult already holds them and discards them at MarkdownPlanParser.cs:128; advisor contract gains the checkpoints key; apply syncs the graph; W4.2 init --from-idea + advisor block; W4.3 advisor split-into-subtasks + stage-level card add; W4.4 per-item qa inherit/verify/off honored by QaPolicy — same live-proof shape as P2QaDialLiveTests). Determinism principle holds: the advisor acts only on explicit owner invocation.

stages.title: Proof run
stages.notes: W5.1 credential-free dress rehearsal: import a 3-stage toy plan from markdown, drive it end-to-end with fake-agent, exercise every in-flight lever mid-run (add card, split, per-item QA flip, context edit, plan edit) — first RunFinished event ever. W5.2 HUMAN: owner-started real-model unattended run start->RunFinished, budget-capped, watch-run armed but idle; audit the five acceptance criteria in docs/workgraph/W5-AUDIT.md with run.db/log evidence. Fix what bleeds; re-run until clean.

stages.title: GitHub-ready
stages.notes: Deliver W6 per docs/CONDUCTOR-WORKGRAPH.md (W6.1 HUMAN: license choice + publish/ purge decision, .gitignore/.gitattributes; W6.2 .github/workflows/ci.yml windows full battery + ubuntu dotnet/go legs, dotnet 10.x / go 1.26, ratchet via pwsh at tools/gates/ratchet.ps1 — exact path, wrong path exits 0; W6.3 README prereqs/platform/badges + VHS demo GIF of conductor-face --demo, fix docs/quickstart.md .NET version; W6.4 archive historical trackers, scrub foreign-project refs and evidence gate logs, CONTRIBUTING/SECURITY, merge feat/foreman -> master). Runs after W5 so CI is born green on the fixed engine.
